_note: ESP Web Tools manifest for the HomeControl firmware (doc/network.md 'Improv / web flasher', doc/ota.md). The part paths are relative to this file. The offsets are the 4 MB OTA layout (platform/esp/partitions-4MB.csv), which also runs on 8 and 16 MB modules: bootloader 0x0, partition table 0x8000, updater (factory) 0x10000, application (ota_0) 0x100000, and an otadata image that selects ota_0 at 0x3b0000, so the first boot starts the application, and the LittleFS image with the web UI in the storage partition at 0x3b2000 (doc/web.md). scripts/flasher-local.sh copies a build into firmware/esp32c6/ (not versioned) and checks these offsets against the build's flasher_args.json. For a release the binaries are the GitHub release assets, https://github.com/haumacher/homecontrol/releases/download/<tag>/<asset> (pattern to be filled when the first release is cut); release downloads may lack CORS headers, in which case the release workflow copies the assets next to this manifest (GitHub Pages) instead.
